steps.summary: In Step 1, I tapped the red-marked leftmost button in the calculator’s top keypad row, identified by the action as “清除”. The display was blank, with an orange cursor near the right edge. The keypad showed %, delete, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, and 1–3, plus 00, 0, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and an orange = key. No expression or result was visible.

In Step 1, I tapped the red-marked ‘清除’ key at the far left of the function row on the calculator screen. The selected ‘计算’ tab appeared beside ‘换算’ and ‘税贷’; the history showed ‘125+75=200’ and ‘125+=125’, and the current display read ‘0’. The keypad also showed percent and division controls, number keys 0–9, decimal point, multiplication, subtraction, addition, and equals.

In Step 2, I tapped the calculator’s “4” key, with the red marker centered on the left key in the row containing 5, 6, and −. The screen shows a blank display area, with no expression or result visible. The keypad also shows AC, %, delete, ÷, 7, 8, 9, ×, 1, 2, 3, +, 00, 0, a decimal point, and =; the status bar reads 06:43.

In Step 2, I tapped the red-marked “1” key at the lower-left of the numeric keypad on the calculator’s “计算” tab. The screen also showed the “换算” and “税贷” tabs, a display reading “0” above a thin divider, and keys for AC, backspace, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, 0, a decimal point, arithmetic operators, and an orange equals button; no expression or result other than “0” was visible.

In Step 3, I tapped the ‘8’ key marked in red on the calculator screen. The large display showed ‘4’; no expression or result ‘8’ was visible. The keypad showed AC, %, backspace, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, 00, 0, a decimal point, ×, −, +, and =. The calculator toolbar and phone status bar were visible above it.

In Step 3, I tapped the “2” key marked in red on the calculator keypad. This frame shows the “计算” tab selected beside “换算” and “税贷,” with the display reading “1” and “= 1.” The keypad shows C, backspace, percent, division, digits 7 through 9, 4 through 6, 1 through 3, 0, a decimal point, and the orange multiplication, subtraction, addition, and equals controls.

In Step 4, I tapped the far-right circular crosshair icon marked in red in the calculator’s top function row; the visible key has no “除” label. The display read “48”. The keypad showed “AC”, “%”, delete, 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, “00”, “0”, decimal point, “×”, “−”, “+”, and “=”, with no division key or “48÷6” expression visible. The status bar showed 06:44.

In Step 5, I tapped the red-marked “6” key on the calculator keypad. The display showed “48÷”, with no result visible. The screen also showed the status bar at 06:44, top controls for expand, math functions, keypad layout, and more options, plus rows of keys labeled AC, %, backspace, ÷, 7, 8, 9, ×, 4, 5, 6, −, 1, 2, 3, +, 00, 0, decimal point, and =.

In Step 4, I tapped the “5” key marked in red on the calculator’s “计算” screen. The display showed “12” with “= 12” beneath it. The visible keypad included C, delete, %, ÷, 7, 8, 9, ×, 4, 5, 6, −, 1, 2, 3, +, 0, a decimal point, and an orange equals button; the top tabs were “计算”, “换算”, and “税贷”.

In Step 6, I tapped the orange equals button marked by the red target at the lower right of the calculator keypad. The display showed “48÷6” in large text and a smaller gray “8” beneath it. The keypad showed AC, %, delete, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, 1–3, 00, 0, decimal, ×, −, and +; the status bar read 06:45.

In Step 5, I tapped the plus (+) key in the rightmost operator column, where the red marker landed. The calculator screen showed the orange-highlighted “计算” tab beside “换算” and “税贷.” The expression area displayed “125” with the gray preview “= 125.” Below it were C, backspace, %, and ÷; number rows 7–9, 4–6, and 1–3; ×, −, and +; and the bottom row with a switch icon, 0, decimal point, and orange equals button.

In Step 6, I tapped the red-marked “7” key in the calculator keypad. The Chinese calculator screen showed the selected “计算” tab beside “换算” and “税贷”; the expression display read “125+” with the gray preview “=125”. The visible keypad included C, delete, %, ÷, 7, 8, 9, ×, 4, 5, 6, −, 1, 2, 3, +, a conversion icon, 0, a decimal point, and the orange equals button.

In Step 7, I tapped the red-marked “5” key in the keypad of the calculator screen. The top tabs read “计算” (selected in orange), “换算,” and “税贷”; the expression display showed “125+7” with the preview “= 132.” Above the keypad were “C,” a delete key, “%,” and “÷”; the keypad also showed number keys and orange “×,” “−,” “+,” and “=” controls.

In Step 8, I tapped the lower-right orange circular control identified as “等于,” beneath the red target marker. The selected tab was “计算,” beside “换算” and “税贷”; the expression read “125+75” and its preview read “= 200.” The keypad showed C, delete, %, ÷, digits 7–9, 4–6, and 1–3, plus 0, a decimal point, ×, −, and +; a swap icon was at bottom left.

In Step 8, I tapped the calculator’s plus (+) key marked by the red target, at the right of the row containing 1, 2, and 3. The display showed the gray expression “48÷6” above the large black result “8.” The visible keypad also had AC, %, delete, ÷, 7–9, ×, 4–6, −, 00, 0, decimal point, and orange = keys; the status bar read 06:52 and showed 100% battery.

In Step 9, I tapped the “1” key marked in red at the left of the 1–2–3 row on the calculator. The display read “8+”. The visible keypad included AC, %, delete, ÷, 7–9, ×, 4–6, −, 1–3, +, 00, 0, a decimal point, and the orange = key. The top bar also showed expand arrows, √/π and e= symbols, a grid icon, and a three-dot menu; the status bar showed 06:53.

In Step 10, I tapped the red-marked 7 key in the calculator keypad. The screen showed the expression “8+1” in large type and a gray “9” beneath it. The keypad displayed AC, %, delete, ÷, 7, 8, 9, ×, 4, 5, 6, −, 1, 2, 3, +, 00, 0, a decimal key, and an orange = key; the red marker covered the 7 key. The status bar showed 06:54 and 100% battery.

In Step 11, I tapped the orange equals button marked in red at the bottom right of the calculator. I saw “8+17” in black on the display, with a gray “25” beneath it. I also saw the keypad with AC, %, backspace, and ÷; 7, 8, 9, and ×; 4, 5, 6, and −; 1, 2, 3, and +; and 00, 0, and a decimal point. The status bar showed 06:54 and 100% battery.
